items.source: Define a QueryRewriter that should be applied to the query string after the query is fully assembled.
items.translation: 定义一个QueryRewriter，该接口应在查询完全组装后应用于查询字符串。

items.source: Defines the JPA query to be executed when the annotated method is called.
items.translation: 定义当调用带注解的方法时要执行的 JPA 查询。

items.source: When using a native query, a @NativeQuery variant is available.
items.translation: 使用原生查询时，可以使用@NativeQuery变体。

items.source: Defines the projection part of the count query that is generated for pagination. If neither countQuery() nor countProjection() is configured we will derive the count query from the original query.
items.translation: 定义用于分页生成的计数查询的投影部分。如果未配置countQuery()或countProjection()，则将从原始查询中推导计数查询。

items.source: Defines a special count query that shall be used for pagination queries to look up the total number of elements for a page. If none is configured we will derive the count query from the original query or countProjection() query if any.
items.translation: 定义一个用于分页查询的特殊计数查询，以查找页面的总元素数量。如果未配置任何内容，则将从原始查询或（如果有）countProjection() 查询中推导计数查询。

items.source: The named query to be used. If not defined, a NamedQuery with name of ${domainClass}.${queryMethodName} will be used.
items.translation: 要使用的命名查询。如果未定义，将使用名称为${domainClass}.${queryMethodName}的NamedQuery。

items.source: Returns the name of the NamedQuery to be used to execute count queries when pagination is used. Will default to the named query name configured suffixed by .count.
items.translation: 返回用于在分页时执行计数查询的NamedQuery名称。默认情况下，将使用配置的名称后附加.count后缀的命名查询名称。

items.source: Returns the name of the NamedQuery to be used to execute count queries when pagination is used.
items.translation: 返回在分页时用于执行计数查询的NamedQuery的名称。

items.source: Defines the projection part of the count query that is generated for pagination.
items.translation: 定义用于分页生成的计数查询的投影部分。

items.source:
Defines a special count query that shall be used for pagination queries to look up the total number of elements for

items.translation: 定义一个特殊的计数查询，用于分页查询时查找页面的总元素数量。

items.source: The named query to be used.
Configures whether the given query is a native one.
items.translation: 配置给定查询是否为原生查询。

items.source: Configures whether the given query is a native one. Defaults to false.
items.translation: 配置给定的查询是否为原生查询。默认值为 false。

items.translation: 用于在仓库查询方法上直接声明 Finder 查询的注解。
